Deep Six is a PvP Brawl where two teams of six Alliance and Horde players face off in a resource race across three classic battlegrounds including Warsong Gulch, Silvershard Mines, and Temple of Kotmogu. Each map has its own twist (for example, flags spawn closer in Warsong Gulch, fewer carts in Silvershard Mines, and only two orbs in Temple of Kotmogu), and the first side to reach the resource cap wins.

.]] Decor Duels are a hide-and-seek style minigame in which players take turns disguising themselves as ordinary objects while other players have to figure out which objects are actually players. An old magister and spellbreaker training exercise, the game was revitalized by Aethas Sunreaver, Auric Sunchaser, and Maella after the events of the March on Quel'Danas.

in Azj-Kahet]] Deepwalkers are an ancient race of giant, tusked, elemental creatures found in Khaz Algar. They are territorial and capable of speaking. Also, they are vulnerable to the Black Blood, which caused a colony of them to be corrupted. In combat, they fight by smashing the ground in front of themselves, inflicting damage and knocking nearby enemies into the air. They are also known to become enraged during combat, making them more durable and agile.

Defeating the Underpin concludes the The War Within Season 2 storyline for delves. To complete this quest, players must defeat The Underpin in his Demolition Dome challenge delve in northern Undermine, which requires clearing a Tier 7 delve with lives remaining to unlock.

Deepflayers are bat-like beasts found in underground regions like Zaralek Cavern and the Ringing Deeps. Deepflayers come in both winged and wingless variants. Their bodies are covered in rocky protrusions. They are vicious and stubborn and will often attack nearby settlements. Niffen will occasionally consume deepflayer meat and some of them use deepflayer claws as weapons. They are very confrontational, and they prey upon deepstriders and krolusks.

Defying Gravity is awarded to players who defeat Dimensius, the All-Devouring after allowing every member of your raid to be hit by Reverse Gravity at least once in the Manaforge Omega on Normal difficulty or higher. This is one of the criteria of Glory of the Omega Raider. This achievement is earned entirely in phase one of the encounter. After splitting into two parts after the initial knockback, extra players should stand in the Reverse Gravity circles instead of just the targeted raid members. Save the launched players by using Excess Mass as normal. Rinse and repeat until all players have been launched.

Delve into the Earth serves as an introduction to Delves, the tentpole solo and small-group feature of .

Delves are a solo/small-group pillar of progression introduced in . An iteration of scenarios from , Delves are role-agnostic mini-dungeons for one to five players that can be completed in 10-15 minutes, with objectives that change daily. Players will tag along with a companion and explore different delves as part of the expansion. Delves provide experience and gear, all the way up to Mythic+5/Heroic raid-level equipment. Cosmetic and collectible rewards are also available, including customizable mounts with each new season (e.g. the Delver's Dirigible introduced with The War Within Season 1).
